description: This file is a shell script that implements a test suite for verifying merge behaviors in Git, including custom merge drivers, attribute-based merge control, conflict handling, and merge conflict resolution scenarios.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a successful test case that expects the preceding commands to succeed.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers commands to run after the test to clean up or finalize.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Utility to search for a pattern in output.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expecting it to fail.

methods.name: test_write_lines
methods.description: Utility to write multiple lines to a file.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test suite execution.
